interface.title: Digital Twin — Endurance (Streamlit dashboard, French UI)
interface.field: Sports science / exercise physiology (training-load dose-response modelling)
interface.stage_of_work: Results review and validation: it reads only pre-computed artefacts and does not compute them again
interface.what_it_is_for: Look at one athlete's TRIMP-based fitness/fatigue/ACWR curves and rolling performance envelope, compare dose-response model variants out of sample, and review results across a 61-athlete cohort (replication, hierarchical pooling, planner safety-rule validation, responder predictors).

data.note: Bundled demo snapshot (demo/processed) of GoldenCheetah OpenData: 917 real sessions, Aug 2014 → Jan 2020, with cohort/pool artefacts. The blue sidebar 'Demo' banner confirms that nothing is recomputed (`python -m src.cli ingest` regenerates it locally). No upload or ingestion was used.

features.name: Fitness–fatigue (impulse-response) load curves with tunable time constants
features.general: Turn a daily load series into two exponentially weighted moving averages plus their difference, and retune the two time constants to see the curves and the current-value summary update
features.specific: Charge page: sidebar sliders 'Constante de fitness (j)' (20–90) and 'Constante de fatigue (j)' (3–25) redraw the Fitness/Fatigue/Fraicheur TRIMP curves and the metric cards
steps: Read the current Fitness/Fatigue/Fraicheur cards
Drag or key the fitness constant slider
Drag or key the fatigue constant slider
Toggle traces from the legend to isolate one curve
Zoom or hover the chart for dated values
serves_tasks: Inspect smoothed load curves and how sensitive they are to the smoothing time constants

features.name: Ratio time series with threshold line and box zoom
features.general: Plot a ratio over time against a fixed alert threshold; box-zoom into an episode, hover to read exact dated values, double-click to reset
features.specific: ACWR (7 vs 28 days) chart with dashed 'seuil 1.5' line, Plotly zoom/pan/reset
steps: Scan the full-period ratio against the threshold
Drag a box over a period of interest
Hover a spike to read date and value
Double-click to zoom back out
serves_tasks: Check an acute-to-chronic load ratio against a threshold over time

features.name: Rolling-best envelope with window slider and per-discipline tabs
features.general: Overlay a rolling maximum on noisy per-event measurements, change the window length and switch between data streams, and watch the lag-1 autocorrelation and latest envelope value update
features.specific: Performance page: 'Fenetre de l'enveloppe (jours)' slider (14–120, 7-day steps) + Course/Velo tabs, with Observations/Autocorrelation/Enveloppe actuelle cards over the scatter + envelope line
steps: Read autocorrelation at the default 42-day window
Shorten the window and compare
Switch to the other discipline tab
Push the window to maximum and compare again
serves_tasks: Compare how predictable a rolling-best outcome is versus raw per-session values, for several window lengths

features.name: Computed metric cross-checked against a reference implementation
features.general: Scatter a metric you computed against the same metric from a reference tool, with the identity line, and read slope, intercept and residual SD to judge agreement
features.specific: Seances page: TRIMP vs GoldenCheetah TRIMP scatter with identity line, cards for slope (0.934), intercept (+1.0) and residual SD (15.6), plus per-sport session counts
steps: Open the Seances page
Compare the scatter to the identity line
Read slope, intercept and residual SD cards
Check the per-sport session counts
serves_tasks: Check the computed load metric against a reference and browse per-session records

features.name: Readiness ladder: capability checklist
features.general: Show how many planned analyses the available data already supports for one subject, as a count and a yes/no list naming what is still missing
features.specific: Mesures › Maturite: 'Capacites disponibles N / M' metric with oui/non checklist lines (6 / 6, all 'oui', for the demo athlete)
steps: Open the Maturite tab
Read the available-capabilities count
Scan the oui/non lines for what is missing
serves_tasks: Check which analyses one subject's data can already support, and what is still missing, as a readiness ladder

features.name: Model-variant leaderboard: in-sample vs out-of-sample
features.general: Pick the outcome to explain, then read a ranked table and paired bar chart of in-sample fit vs cross-validated skill for many model variants, with an automatic verdict banner on the best variant or on 'nothing beats the mean'
features.specific: Diagnostics: 'Grandeur a expliquer' radio (Enveloppe course / Effort de seance) → green/red banner, variant table (R² ajustement, R² hors echantillon, ecart, RMSE, gain/moyenne), bar chart, 'Calibration de l'athlete' expander
steps: Choose the outcome radio
Read the verdict banner
Scan the ranked table and the ecart column
Compare grey vs blue bars in the chart
Optionally open athlete calibration
serves_tasks: Rank model variants by in-sample fit versus out-of-sample skill for a chosen outcome

features.name: Discipline-matched load comparison with paired-gain confidence tables and protocol switcher
features.general: Compare load from the outcome's own discipline against load from another discipline (negative control) and the mean, per target, using paired gains with confidence intervals, and re-run the comparison under another cross-validation protocol
features.specific: Mesures › Appariement ('Apparier la charge a la discipline de la cible'): 'Comparaisons appariees' tables (gain, IC bas, IC haut, P(gain)) for Cible course and Cible velo; 'Protocole' select (blocs / horizon 28j / cible velo cp20) → R² bar chart and table with 'plis'
steps: Open the Appariement tab
Scroll to the paired comparisons for each target
Check whether the matched-vs-mismatched gain CI excludes zero
Pick another protocol from the Protocole dropdown
Read the redrawn R² chart and fold count
serves_tasks: Test whether load from the outcome's own discipline predicts it better than load from another discipline (a negative control) and the mean, using paired gains with confidence intervals, and whether this holds across validation protocols

features.name: Model skill against effort duration
features.general: Plot each model variant's cross-validated skill as a line across effort durations, to see where one variant stops outperforming another
features.specific: Mesures › Par duree: R² hors echantillon vs duree d'effort (s), lines for persistance, moyenne and two Banister variants
steps: Open the Par duree tab
Follow each variant's line across durations
Compare variants at short vs long durations
serves_tasks: Plot each model variant's out-of-sample skill against effort duration

features.name: Detectability-floor curve
features.general: Inject known effects of increasing size and plot the estimated gain against them, one line per reference model and one panel per outcome, to read the smallest effect the protocol can detect
features.specific: Mesures › Plancher: paired gain vs injected effect (envelope SDs) per target, lines vs moyenne and vs persistance
steps: Open the Plancher tab
Pick a target panel
Find the injected effect at which the gain separates from zero for each reference
serves_tasks: Read the smallest effect the validation protocol can detect for each outcome, by injecting known effects; a null result below this floor is not evidence of no effect

features.name: Per-subject forest plot with CI-excludes-zero counts
features.general: Show each subject's effect estimate with its interval, sorted, then count how many intervals exclude zero in each direction, and compare detected vs undetected groups
features.specific: Mesures › Cohorte: 'gain apparie, IC 95 %' forest plot over 61 athletes, hover per athlete, cards Athletes / IC excluant zero en faveur / contre, heterogeneity table
steps: Scan the sorted forest plot
Hover an outlier to read its ID and interval
Read the excludes-zero counts
Compare medians in the detectes / non detectes table
serves_tasks: Count how many subjects show an effect whose confidence interval excludes zero

features.name: Hierarchical posterior summary with sensitivity-control comparison
features.general: Read pooled posterior parameters with diagnostics, compare them across a published run, a control run and a perturbed-setting run, then view per-subject posterior intervals
features.specific: Mesures › Mise en commun: ArviZ-style table (mean, sd, hdi_3%, hdi_97%, ess, r_hat), publie/controle/fenetre reduite table, interpretive note, 'effet net, HDI 94 %' per-athlete plot
steps: Check convergence (r_hat, ess) in the posterior table
Compare tau1/tau2 across publie, controle and fenetre reduite
Read the elasticity note
Inspect per-athlete HDIs
serves_tasks: Review hierarchical Bayesian pooled parameters and a sensitivity/control analysis

features.name: Decision-rule verdict chart
features.general: Score each rule × regime × statistic by the outcome difference between respecting and violating it, colour-coded as contradicted / supported / indeterminate, with a backing table of n, p and verdict
features.specific: Mesures › Regles du plan: horizontal bars 'ecart d'issue respect − violation' for ACWR>=0.8, ACWR<=1.5 and 'au plus 3 jours consecutifs', with table regle/regime/statistique/athletes/ecart/en faveur/p/plancher/verdict
steps: Read the colour of each rule's bars
Compare the 'toutes les semaines' and 'reference >= 15 obs' regimes
Check p and verdict in the table
serves_tasks: Validate decision-rule thresholds against observed outcomes

features.name: Predictor screen against a detectable-correlation threshold
features.general: Plot each subject characteristic's rank correlation with the effect against ± the smallest correlation the sample size can detect, with a table flagging significance
features.specific: Mesures › Qui repond: rho per predictor vs 'seuil detectable' markers, table with rho detectable (≈0.25, n=61) and 'significatif' column
steps: Open the Qui repond tab
Compare each predictor's rho to the detectable markers
Read rho detectable and the significatif column in the table
serves_tasks: Screen subject characteristics as predictors of who responds

features.general: Sort a results table by a column, search its cells and step through matches, and hide columns you do not need
features.specific: Streamlit's built-in dataframe toolbar on Seances Detail, Diagnostics and Mesures tables: header click to sort, Search box with result count and next/previous, Show/hide columns checklist
steps: Click a column header to sort
Open Search and type a term
Press Enter to jump to a match
Open Show/hide columns and untick a column
serves_tasks: Check the computed load metric against a reference and browse per-session records
Screen subject characteristics as predictors of who responds

screens_never_reached: The per-tab CLI regeneration command (e.g. `src.cli cohort`, `src.cli pool`) that appears when an artefact is missing: all artefacts are bundled, so these hints never appeared
Live ingestion mode (anything other than the Demo snapshot): not available from the UI
not_done: Downloading tables as CSV: clicking 'Download as CSV' on the Seances Detail table and on the Appariement paired-comparison table produced no download (browser_downloads stayed empty). Only the Plotly 'Download plot as a PNG' worked (plot-image.png).
Toggling legend categories on the Regles du plan chart: the click landed under the Plotly toolbar and nothing changed. Legend toggling was confirmed only on the Charge chart.
Help tooltips (the ? icons next to Fitness and Autocorrelation): hovering returned no tooltip text, so their content was not read.
Recomputing protocols (ingest/cohort/pool): by design the dashboard never recomputes them, and no shell was available.
applied: Reframed t7 general and specific labels around discipline-matched load vs mismatched load (negative control) and the mean, citing the bike-power paired gain the reviewer verified on 049
Kept the protocol switch as nested sub-task n1 (branch 'repeat') inside t7
Renamed and rewrote f5 as the discipline-matched paired-gain comparison and added 031 to its screens
Split t8 into sub-tasks n2 (skill against effort duration) and n3 (detectability floor per target, read as a property of the protocol)
Moved t9 (Maturite) into the single-athlete phase and described it as a readiness ladder
Removed t5's 'one-of' branch so its steps form a sequence, and noted in the labels that only the outcome radio is an alternative

Added features f10 (TRIMP cross-check), f11 (readiness checklist), f12 (skill vs duration), f13 (detectability-floor curve) and f14 (predictor screen), each taking its check from the replay of the task it serves
Noted in f9 that its toolbar is Streamlit's built-in, and added the 7-day step to f3
open_fixes: The per-duration paired-gain table on Par duree ('Charge specifique contre persistance, duree par duree') still needs to be added to n2 and f12. The explorer opened the tab and left without scrolling, so no kept screen shows the table or where the gap stops excluding zero.

The detectability-floor values (2 σ for the running target, 1 σ for the bike target) still need to go into n3 and f13. No kept screen was checked for them, and the replay saw only the Cible course panel, so a new run should capture both panels.

The readiness ladder's incomplete state still needs to be described: 'non' lines naming what is missing, the days still needed, and the cohort prior shown when a verdict is unavailable. The demo athlete is at 6 / 6, so recording it needs an athlete or snapshot with less data.
